fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: All visitors to Lesotho must travel through South Africa, by air or land, and need to meet South Africa's entry requirements.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes de Lesoto deben pasar por Sudáfrica, por aire o tierra, y cumplir sus requisitos de entrada.
entry.quote: All visitors to Lesotho must travel through South Africa, whether travelling by air or land.

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 90 days after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 90 días después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You need at least 4 blank pages for stamping, as both Lesotho and South African border control stamp your passport.
entry.es: Necesitas al menos 4 páginas en blanco para los sellos, porque tanto Lesoto como Sudáfrica sellan tu pasaporte.
entry.quote: You need at least 4 blank pages for passport stamping.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques in any currency worth 25,000 Lesotho loti or more, or the money could be seized.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viaje en cualquier moneda por 25.000 lotis o más, o el dinero podría ser confiscado.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques in any currency if the value is 25,000 Lesotho loti or more.

entry.en: Proof of a return or onward ticket or your future travel plans might be asked for.
entry.es: Puede que se pida prueba de un billete de vuelta o de continuación, o de tus planes de viaje.
entry.quote: The proof of a return or onward ticket or your future travel plans might be asked

entry.en: Rented cars need written permission from the rental company, which you must show at border control.
entry.es: Los coches de alquiler necesitan un permiso escrito de la empresa de alquiler, que debes mostrar en la frontera.
entry.quote: You will need to show written permission from the rental company at border control.

safety.en: Muggers can target foreign nationals, so do not walk alone in isolated areas or after dark.
safety.es: Los asaltantes pueden elegir a extranjeros, así que no camines solo por zonas aisladas ni después de oscurecer.
safety.quote: Muggers can target foreign nationals. Do not walk alone in isolated areas or after dark.

safety.en: Armed carjackers or robbers may try to stop your car or get into it while you are stationary.
safety.es: Ladrones armados o secuestradores de coches pueden intentar detener tu coche o entrar en él cuando estás parado.
safety.quote: Armed carjackers or robbers may try to stop your car or get into it while you are stationary.

safety.en: Gender-based violence is very high in Lesotho.
safety.es: La violencia de género es muy alta en Lesoto.
safety.quote: Gender-based violence is very high in Lesotho.

safety.en: Sexual activity between men is illegal, but FCDO is not aware of this being enforced.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre hombres es ilegal, pero el FCDO no tiene constancia de que se aplique.
safety.quote: Sexual activity between men is illegal, but FCDO is not aware of this being enforced.

safety.en: There are occasional political demonstrations in Maseru, usually peaceful, with a risk of isolated incidents of violence.
safety.es: Hay manifestaciones políticas ocasionales en Maseru, normalmente pacíficas, con riesgo de incidentes violentos aislados.
safety.quote: There are occasional political demonstrations in Maseru. These are usually peaceful, but there is a risk of isolated incidents of violence.

safety.en: Animals roaming on the roads are a hazard, especially at night.
safety.es: Los animales sueltos en las carreteras son un peligro, sobre todo de noche.
safety.quote: Animals roaming on the roads are a hazard, especially at night.

health.en: The water in Lesotho is not clean and should not be drunk untreated.
health.es: El agua en Lesoto no está limpia y no debe beberse sin tratar.
health.quote: The water in Lesotho is not clean and should not be drunk untreated.

health.en: Lesotho has basic medical facilities, and most foreign visitors use healthcare facilities in Bloemfontein, South Africa.
health.es: Lesoto tiene instalaciones médicas básicas, y la mayoría de los visitantes extranjeros usan centros de Bloemfontein, en Sudáfrica.
health.quote: Lesotho has basic medical facilities. Most foreign visitors use healthcare facilities in Bloemfontein, South Africa

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Lesotho.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Lesoto.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Lesotho.

health.en: Malaria, yellow fever and bilharzia are stated as not present in Lesotho.
health.es: Se indica que la malaria, la fiebre amarilla y la bilharziasis no están presentes en Lesoto.
health.quote: Tropical diseases such as malaria, yellow fever and bilharzia are not present in Lesotho.

health.en: Vaccinations will most likely include hep A, hep B and typhoid, and a rabies shot is suggested for long rural stays.
health.es: Las vacunas probablemente incluyan hepatitis A, hepatitis B y tifoidea, y se sugiere la de la rabia para estancias largas en zonas rurales.
health.quote: they will most likely include hep A, hep B, and typhoid. If you are staying in rural areas for a long time then a rabies shot would be a good idea.

health.en: The HIV/AIDS incidence rate in Lesotho is stated to be the 3rd highest in the world, at around 25%.
health.es: Se indica que la incidencia de VIH/sida en Lesoto es la tercera más alta del mundo, de alrededor del 25%.
health.quote: The HIV/AIDS incidence rate in Lesotho is the 3rd highest in the world at around 25% or 1 in 4 people infected.

help.en: The emergency number in Lesotho is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Lesoto es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: If 112 is not operating for medical emergencies, call locally on 80093030121.
help.es: Si el 112 no funciona para emergencias médicas, llama localmente al 80093030121.
help.quote: If 112 is not operating, call locally on 80093030121.

help.en: Queen Mamohato Memorial Hospital and Maseru Private Hospital are the main hospitals, both in the Maseru area.
help.es: El Queen Mamohato Memorial Hospital y el Maseru Private Hospital son los principales hospitales, ambos en la zona de Maseru.
help.quote: Queen Mamohato Memorial Hospital (+266 2231 3260) and Maseru Private Hospital (+266 2233 3600) are the main hospitals.

help.en: For serious health problems, contact your embassy in Maseru or in most cases in Pretoria, South Africa.
help.es: Ante problemas graves de salud, contacta con tu embajada en Maseru o, en la mayoría de los casos, en Pretoria, Sudáfrica.
help.quote: get in contact with your country's embassy either in Maseru, or in most cases, in Pretoria in South Africa

getting_in.en: Moshoeshoe Airport is 18km from Maseru, with daily flights to Johannesburg by South African Airways and Airlink.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Moshoeshoe está a 18 km de Maseru, con vuelos diarios a Johannesburgo de South African Airways y Airlink.
getting_in.quote: Moshoeshoe Airport is located 18km from Maseru. South African Airways and Airlink operate daily flights between Maseru and Johannesburg

getting_in.en: You should arrange taxi pick-up in advance as often there are no taxis at the airport.
getting_in.es: Conviene organizar la recogida en taxi con antelación, ya que a menudo no hay taxis en el aeropuerto.
getting_in.quote: You should arrange taxi pick-up in advance as often there are no taxis at the airport.

getting_in.en: Only Maseru Bridge and Ficksburg Bridge border posts are open 24 hours; others can close as early as 16:00.
getting_in.es: Solo los pasos fronterizos de Maseru Bridge y Ficksburg Bridge abren 24 horas; los demás pueden cerrar desde las 16:00.
getting_in.quote: only Maseru Bridge and Ficksburg Bridge are open 24 hours; other borders can close as early as 16:00.

getting_in.en: There is no train line within Lesotho.
getting_in.es: No hay línea de tren dentro de Lesoto.
getting_in.quote: There is no train line within Lesotho

getting_in.en: Vaal-Maseru runs a coach service between Johannesburg and Maseru.
getting_in.es: Vaal-Maseru opera un servicio de autocar entre Johannesburgo y Maseru.
getting_in.quote: Vaal-Maseru runs a coach service between Johannesburg and Maseru.

getting_around.en: Minibus taxis are the transport of the people, and prices are fixed by the government.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses taxi son el transporte de la gente, y los precios los fija el gobierno.
getting_around.quote: Prices are fixed by the government. There is a risk of overcharging foreigners so ask the other passengers if you’re unsure of the price.

getting_around.en: Intercity taxi travel costs no more than M50 one way, and inner-city minibus rides around M2.50.
getting_around.es: Un viaje interurbano en taxi cuesta como máximo 50 M por trayecto, y uno urbano en minibús unos 2,50 M.
getting_around.quote: Intercity travel by taxi will cost no more than M50 (maloti) for a single way ticket, and inner city minibus taxi rides will cost you around M2.50

getting_around.en: Always check the cost of a taxi before you get in.
getting_around.es: Comprueba siempre el precio del taxi antes de subir.
getting_around.quote: Always check the cost of a taxi before you get in.

getting_around.en: Minibus taxis tend to be poorly maintained and are not insured.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses taxi suelen estar mal mantenidos y no tienen seguro.
getting_around.quote: The Minibus taxis tend to be poorly maintained and are not insured.

getting_around.en: In Maseru, minibus taxis leave from Setopong on Moeshoeshoe Road.
getting_around.es: En Maseru, los minibuses taxi salen de Setopong, en Moeshoeshoe Road.
getting_around.quote: In Maseru, there is a place called Setopong on Moeshoeshoe Road

getting_around.en: You don't need a 4x4 for the main sights; for the average visitor only the road to Semonkong needs one.
getting_around.es: No hace falta un 4x4 para los principales lugares; para el visitante medio solo la carretera a Semonkong lo requiere.
getting_around.quote: You don't need a 4x4 to see the main sights in Lesotho, for the average visitor only the road to Semonkong will need a 4x4.

money.en: The loti (plural maloti) is fixed at 1:1 with the South African rand, which is accepted everywhere.
money.es: El loti (plural maloti) está fijado 1:1 con el rand sudafricano, que se acepta en todas partes.
money.quote: It is fixed at a 1:1 ratio with the South African rand (ZAR)

money.en: Both the loti and the rand are accepted throughout Lesotho.
money.es: Tanto el loti como el rand se aceptan en todo Lesoto.
money.quote: Both currencies are accepted throughout Lesotho.

money.en: Credit cards are accepted in Shoprite and the main hotels, but not elsewhere.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito se aceptan en Shoprite y los principales hoteles, pero no en otros sitios.
money.quote: Credit cards will be accepted in Shoprite and the main hotels, but not elsewhere.

money.en: There are ATMs at banks in most towns, although you will not find them elsewhere.
money.es: Hay cajeros en los bancos de la mayoría de las ciudades, pero no en otros lugares.
money.quote: There are ATMs at banks in most towns, although you will not find them elsewhere.

money.en: If travelling outside Maseru, take enough cash to cover local purchases.
money.es: Si viajas fuera de Maseru, lleva suficiente efectivo para tus compras locales.
money.quote: If you are travelling outside Maseru, take enough cash to cover local purchases.

etiquette.en: Always refer to an elder or a person of higher social standing as "Ntate" (male) or "'Me" (female).
etiquette.es: Dirígete siempre a una persona mayor o de más rango social como "Ntate" (hombre) o "'Me" (mujer).
etiquette.quote: Always refer to an elder person, or a person of higher social standing as "Ntate" (male) or " 'Me " (female).

etiquette.en: It is very offensive to ignore someone who greets you.
etiquette.es: Es muy ofensivo ignorar a alguien que te saluda.
etiquette.quote: It is very offensive to ignore someone who greets you.

etiquette.en: Never get angry at anyone; in Basotho culture people never show frustration towards others.
etiquette.es: Nunca te enfades con nadie; en la cultura basotho la gente nunca muestra frustración hacia los demás.
etiquette.quote: Never get angry at anyone; in the Basotho culture, people never show frustration towards others

etiquette.en: To show respect when giving and receiving items, use both hands.
etiquette.es: Para mostrar respeto al dar y recibir objetos, usa ambas manos.
etiquette.quote: To show respect when giving and receiving items, use both hands.

etiquette.en: Show respect for food: don't throw it around or eat whilst walking.
etiquette.es: Muestra respeto por la comida: no la tires ni comas mientras caminas.
etiquette.quote: Also show a respect for food: don't throw it around, or eat whilst walking.

etiquette.en: Showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention.
etiquette.es: Mostrar afecto en público puede atraer atención no deseada y negativa.
etiquette.quote: Showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention.

connectivity.en: There are two mobile operators, Vodacom and Econet Telecom Lesotho, and both have 4G options.
connectivity.es: Hay dos operadores móviles, Vodacom y Econet Telecom Lesotho, y ambos tienen opciones 4G.
connectivity.quote: There are two mobile operators in Lesotho, Vodacom and Econet Telecom Lesoth

connectivity.en: Vodacom has the widest coverage outside the towns but is the more oversubscribed.
connectivity.es: Vodacom tiene la cobertura más amplia fuera de las ciudades, pero está más saturado.
connectivity.quote: Vodacom has the widest coverage outside the towns, but is the (more) oversubscribed

connectivity.en: You can buy a Vodacom or Ezicel Buddie pay-as-you-go SIM card for under M50 in Maseru.
connectivity.es: Puedes comprar en Maseru una SIM de prepago Vodacom o Ezicel Buddie por menos de 50 M.
connectivity.quote: You can buy a Vodacom or Ezicel Buddie pay as you go sim card for under M50 in Maseru

connectivity.en: The mobile network is OK in the towns but fair out in the countryside.
connectivity.es: La red móvil es aceptable en las ciudades y regular en el campo.
connectivity.quote: The mobile phone network is OK in the towns, but fair out in the countryside.

connectivity.en: A South African Vodacom SIM works in Lesotho only on the Vodacom network, with roaming enabled.
connectivity.es: Una SIM sudafricana de Vodacom solo funciona en Lesoto en la red Vodacom, con el roaming activado.
connectivity.quote: you can use it in Lesotho only on the Vodacom network. Be sure to enable roaming.

phrases.quote: Kea leboha (sounds like kia-lebh-oha) — thank you
U phela joang (O-phela-joang) — how are you

phrases.en: Goodbye (said to the one who stays)
phrases.quote: Sala hantle (as it is written) is "stay well" if they are staying and you are going. Equivalent to goodbye.

phrases.en: Goodbye (said to the one who leaves)
phrases.quote: Tsamaea hantle is "go well" if they are going and you are staying
